description: Safe auto-restart — pod OOMKilled 3 times with stable spec, no broken config
evidence_text: Pod redis-cache-5d7b9-abc12 in namespace multi-agent has been OOMKilled 3 times in the last 30 minutes. Exit code 137 each time. kubectl describe pod shows: Last State: OOMKilled. Memory limit: 512Mi. Current RSS at time of kill: 510-511Mi (hitting limit). ConfigMap 'redis-config' exists and is healthy. Deployment spec is valid — no missing refs. Node has 8Gi free (not node-level pressure). Historical pattern: pod runs ~15 minutes then OOMKills. No CrashLoopBackOff yet (restart count=3, back-off not triggered). Redis maxmemory=400mb is set, but application is allocating buffers above it. Recommendation: increase memory limit to 1Gi and add resource monitoring.
